label: PAY SIGNAL
note: Every entry is re-measured on every run. A drifting residual is a finding, not a warning. The counts are measurements of how a fixed, dated, committed corpus reads under this classifier -- NOT facts about the market. The corpus is fixed precisely so that a change here means the classifier moved, not the world did.
